messages:
Alex (Sales): AcmeProc flagged BCP/DR on the SIG. They want a short pasteable block for RTO/RPO, backups, failover steps, SLA history. Can SRE + Legal provide copy we can drop into their questionnaire? :pray:

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can draft. Quick: Acme ticked "RTO <= 1 hour". Do we ever promise that?

Sam (SRE): Short answers by tier:
- Hosted API: operated for high availability; no contractual RTO/RPO guarantees. Recovery from infra incidents is typically measured in hours.
- Dedicated: SLA-backed uptime (Standard 99.9% / Premium 99.95%). Operational RTO targets for full-environment failover are typically ~2-4 hours depending on topology and warm pools.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed; RTO/RPO are agreed during onboarding and depend on customer infra and backup cadence.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Backups/RPO one-liner I can paste?

Sam (SRE): Backups/RPO (concise): control-plane metadata and audit logs retained per contract; Hosted short-term persistence for request data (not covered by RPO guarantees unless included in Dedicated backup add-on); Dedicated supports point-in-time snapshots; recommended cadence to approach sub-hour RPO is daily full + hourly incrementals (customer config required); Private supports customer-controlled snapshots/replication.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Failover steps (short): 1) health detection + traffic reroute; 2) cache/KV fallback (best-effort); 3) warm-standby promotion if provisioned; 4) DNS/edge failover where configured. Timing depends on topology.

Lena (Legal): Procurement-safe paragraph to paste:
"Redwood Inference operates a tiered service model. Hosted API deployments are operated for high availability but do not include contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Dedicated capacity is covered by contractual uptime SLAs (99.9% standard, 99.95% premium) and documented recovery procedures; specific RTO/RPO values, backup cadences, and runbooks are set forth in the Service Addendum. Private deployments' recovery objectives are agreed case-by-case. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest and audit logging is available. Statements are subject to the Master Services Agreement."

Alex (Sales): They also want evidence of DR tests. Short line for attachment?

Sam (SRE): "We conduct quarterly DR tabletop exercises and annual live failover tests for Dedicated pools. Private customers coordinate tests with their ops teams. A one-page summary of the latest tabletop and associated action items can be provided upon request."

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble: (1) the legal-safe paragraph; (2) the backups/RPO bullets; (3) the failover steps; (4) offer the DR summary + anonymized 12mo availability metrics for Dedicated on request. Will cc Legal and send to AcmeProc.

DR-bot: DR-test-scheduler scheduled: next-tabletop-2026-06-10 16:00 UTC (reminder 7d)

Alex (Sales): Thanks all 033:raised_hands: Action items noted: Priya send pasteable answers + runbook excerpt; Sam prep anonymized 12mo availability and 1-page DR summary; Lena sign off final wording.
